published.source: Second race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16, after dev notes post 8): Undead (follows its base build, rogue__subtlety); verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 740.3 as Night Elf on the same sim)

summary: Subtlety with Murder 2/2, for a Humanoid or Giant boss.
advantage: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants. It does nothing against other bosses.
advantageShort: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants.
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when it's down. Refresh it at 5 when it's about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate. Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less
3-point Rupture when it's not up, with Hemorrhage right before it
Premeditation at 3 combo points or fewer (no Stealth needed)
Vanish into Ambush at 3 combo points or fewer, after pooling energy. A Night Elf uses Shadowmeld the same way. Preparation resets Vanish and Premeditation
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Murder (+4% damage) only works against Humanoids and Giants.
The fight doesn't start in Stealth. Only Vanish, or a Night Elf's Shadowmeld, gives Stealth.
Ghostly Strike adds almost nothing over Hemorrhage (0.5 DPS), but the build requires it.
Open: whether Premeditation works out of Stealth, and what Preparation resets.
Elusiveness changes DPS by 0 at 180s and -2.9 at 300s.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18 DPS.
Grimstitch 4-piece and 5-piece bonuses aren't counted. They would add about 8 and 6 DPS.
Assumed: the fight is in Hyjal or the Barrow Deeps. The flask gives its full bonus only there.
No Flask of Natural Precision. Its 8% hit comes from gear (7% on the wrist, second ring and back) and the 2-piece bonus. That beats 6% hit by 1.2 to 1.9 DPS.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as rogue__subtlety except talents, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeHumanoid, as the class preset's encounter does. Undead since the second 2026-10-27 race re-pick (follows its base build, rogue__subtlety) (after dev notes post 8: Orc Blood Fury 2 min, Troll Berserking 15 s, Undead Touch of the Grave 15 s; the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Night Elf.
